author: Drafted with mentor; reviewed by PM
description: Only the patient's own shorthand notes from a phone call. No written documents. Tests extraction from informal text and many missing topics (the 'missing information' problem).

expected_items.text: The X-rays from urgent care, on a disc

source.quote: bring the xrays from urgent care on a disc

expected_items.text: The clinic is in Building B, 2nd floor

must_not: Invent an arrival time (none is given)
Say that no preparation or no other documents are needed
Treat 'wear shorts or loose pants' as a medical instruction
Correct or 'clean up' the patient's notes in a way that changes their meaning
scoring_notes: Completeness = required found / 3. Main measure here is missing-topic recall (7 expected). Shorthand ('appt', 'xrays') must still be understood.
